about: What scripts/board_fit.js does not count as a fault, and why (MA-240). Each allowance names its board (the end of its path under docs/design/), the fault types, a regular expression on the text and, where it holds only there, the sizes (or `below`, every measured width under it, never the drawn size), a regular expression on the frame's label and one on the element's path. An allowance that matches nothing is reported, so the list stays true. Change a board to fix a fault; add an allowance only for what is drawn on purpose or what an open issue carries, with its reason.
